item.title: Capstone: stitching ten modules into one shippable image-intelligence agent
item.description: End-to-end delivery on ADK Go v2.4.0: a fetch → analyse → human-approval pipeline agent built with workflowagent plus Chain, a FunctionNode for the deterministic fetch, an AgentNode carrying an llmagent, a DynamicNode with ResumeOrRequestInput for HITL, RetryConfig for backoff, OutputKey to pass the brief, a postgres session service for persistence, loggingplugin and retryandreflect for cross-cutting concerns, telemetry.New for observability, universal.NewLauncher with authn.NewIdentityAwareProxy and authz.NewStrict for the web surface, and adkgo deploy cloudrun to publish it. All code passes go build and go vet.
